Extension for 'tmap': cartograms

Source: R/pkg.R
tmap.cartogram-package.Rd

New layer functions for 'tmap' to create cartograms: contiguous cartograms (tm_cartogram()), non-contiguous cartograms (tm_cartogram_ncont()), and Dorling cartograms (tm_cartogram_dorling()). See the article https://r-tmap.github.io/tmap/articles/ext_cartogram.
